name: moe_memory_bound_weight_dominant
description: Fused MoE arithmetic intensity is 0.4-2.0 FLOPs/byte and weights are 99% of bytes; any uplift must reduce weight HBM traffic -- compute-side optimizations have no roofline headroom
preconditions: fmoe kernel with fp8 or smaller weights
steps: Confirm arithmetic intensity via (total_flops / bytes_accessed); expect 0.4-2.0 FLOPs/byte
Confirm weight bytes are ~99% of total by walking the bytes_accessed formula -- if scales+intermediates are >5%, something's off
Before proposing a compute-side optimization (MFMA scheduling, better softmax, etc.), check that it moves weight bytes -- if not, it will show 0% E2E on this kernel
Uplift candidates that DO move the needle: weight compression (fp8 -> fp6/fp4 via f8f6f4 MFMA on gfx950), L2 co-residency of experts, persistent kernels keeping weights resident across tokens
Uplift candidates that DON'T move the needle: MFMA tile shape tuning, LDS padding, VGPR reduction (unless it enables weight-residency via larger blocks)
expected_impact: redirects optimization budget from compute-side micro-tuning to weight-traffic reduction where real headroom lives
decision_rules: If a proposed change doesn't reduce bytes_accessed, reject it as a no-op for fmoe
